correctness.rationale: Every Hilbertian comparison has a positive-definite quadratic form. Permutation averaging preserves two-sided distortion inequalities and reduces its restriction to the zero-sum subspace to the unique centered sum-of-squares form. The exact minimum at unit oscillation is 1/2 by two-point Cauchy inequality and a matching witness. Convexity over the unit cube gives the maximum floor(m^2/4)/m with balanced binary witnesses. Their ratio is the sharp squared distortion; finite-dimensional duality transfers it to the real Lipschitz-free space. All m>=2 and norm normalizations are addressed. Exact-rational finite tests were run from the packaged verify.py and returned EQUILATERAL_EUCLIDEAN_EXACT_OK 9966, but are not relied upon for the infinite-dimensional-parameter proof.

value.rationale: The natural real finite equilateral family is a canonical benchmark in Lipschitz-free geometry. The result determines an exact Banach-space invariant for every cardinality, strengthens arbitrary fixed-dimensional comparisons to a uniform parity-sensitive theorem, and identifies precise balancing and two-point extremizing potentials. The global optimality among all nonsymmetric Euclidean embeddings is an essential geometric step; this is not a table recomputation or merely restating a known free-space norm. The complexity of the task is moderate but the all-dimensional complete invariant and extremal geometry provide substantive value.
